_comment: Named life company capital sources. All parameters verified from lender websites 2026-09-07/10. Spreads shown as 'spread over Treasury' not absolute rates (deal-by-deal). access: 'direct' = open-market submission accepted; 'correspondent' = placed via CLS correspondent relationships.
access_statement: Commercial Lending Solutions places loans with life companies through two channels: direct open-market desks that accept broker submissions, and correspondent programs where our mortgage banking relationships give access to program pricing. In practice this means access to every major life company program below, matched deal-by-deal to whichever desk is actively competing.

lenders.name: New York Life Real Estate Investors
lenders.programs: Permanent fixed; floating-rate; bridge/CTP; subordinated debt from $20M
lenders.spread: Tightest in market for institutional assets
lenders.best_fit: $25M+ institutional multifamily, industrial, office in primary markets

lenders.name: Northwestern Mutual Real Estate
lenders.fixed_term: 5–25 years; fixed over UST or floating over SOFR
lenders.programs: Permanent fixed/floating; JV equity available; in-house appraisal (free to borrower)
lenders.best_fit: $30M+ long-term holds wanting maximum rate certainty

structure_notes: Fully amortizing schedules to 30 years — no balloon risk on the permanent loan
Interest-only periods negotiable for strong sponsorship
Forward commitments: lock today's spread for a delivery 6–18 months out
Non-recourse standard with negotiated, limited carve-outs
Prepayment flexibility structured to the business plan: yield maintenance, declining penalty, or defeasance
Future funding facilities and earn-outs on lease-up assets
Fixed-rate terms to 25–30 years — the longest private-market duration available
sources_note: Program parameters verified from lender-published materials, September 2026. Rates and spreads are indicative and set deal-by-deal; terms shown reflect recently executed transactions and current desk guidance.
